scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:server: uv run --project server --env-file .env lnt-v5 server dev
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:server
scripts.lint:server: cd server && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:client && npm run typecheck:server
scripts.format: cd server && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project server --env-file .env lnt-v5 server migrate
scripts.create-key: uv run --project server --env-file .env lnt-v5 server create-key --name dev --scope admin
